findings.statement: All25 ensemble native misses had zero whole-ball entry and zero retention.
findings.evidence: Original independently audited labels; not a new scoring definition

findings.statement: Only 4 of 13 ensemble requests scored at least99% actually captured.
findings.evidence: All60 requested ensemble outcomes; rejected setups remain in denominator

findings.statement: The first post-board free flight ended at bucket contact in16 misses, robot contact in3, and table contact in6.
findings.evidence: Independent dense force-channel scan; contact cutoff is not by itself proof of rim contact or final capture status

findings.statement: Case36 kept board XY/height/tilt identical to successful BC, raised drop gap36mm, and missed.
findings.evidence: One original nominal shot per action; does not prove a repeatable parameter window

findings.statement: Capture, opening-distance and rebound-velocity heads are independently supervised; ranking does not enforce ballistic consistency.
findings.evidence: Frozen model loss and ranking source; not proof this alone caused a particular miss

findings.statement: Small member disagreement is not calibrated confidence; shared training support can create correlated errors.
findings.evidence: Five shared-architecture bootstrap members; nearestTRAIN proximity is descriptive, not proof of cause

next_steps: Inspect rebound velocity and aperture ranking on these development cases before another fit.
Compare a physically constrained flight score with the independent capture head; keep any resulting tuning separate from this frozen evaluation.
Any changed selector needs new frozen held-out bucket positions. Noise and128-substep testing remain outside this task.
